title: Mod Manifest
description: Schema for mod.json (mod-level metadata). This is separate from scenario metadata.

displayName.description: Display name shown in mod browser

iconPath.description: Relative path to a mod icon image (required if specified in code/UI). When declared, this path is used exclusively — no implicit fallbacks to root icon.png or other defaults.

thumbnailPath.description: Relative path to a larger mod thumbnail/preview image (required if specified in code/UI). When declared, this path is used exclusively — no implicit fallbacks.

startYear.description: Optional suggested start year for UI metadata

version.description: Mod version, semver MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH (e.g. 1.0.0). Dependencies written as id@range are matched against it, and Validate reports a version that is not semver.

workshopItemId.description: Steam Workshop item id when applicable

defaultScenarioFile.description: Relative path to single-file scenario json

scenarioFolder.description: Relative path to split scenario folder; takes precedence over defaultScenarioFile

entrypoints.description: Optional explicit entrypoint declarations for runtime assets.

wasm.description: Relative path to mod WASM entrypoint. Loader checks this first, then falls back to scripts/main.wasm for legacy mods.

ui.description: Relative path to UI injection descriptor. Loader checks this first, then falls back to ui/panels.json for legacy mods.

wasmAbiVersion.description: The script ABI the WASM module was built for (1 to 4). ABI 4 adds the world-state imports and the world.read / flags.write permissions; older imports keep working at every ABI.

enableComponentRuntime.description: Explicit opt-in to allow loading component-model WASM artifacts for this mod. Keep false unless the mod ships component-model binaries and the game runtime has a component backend enabled.

runtimePolicy.description: Declares how this mod's runtime components coexist. coexist=WASM and C# run together (default). wasm_only=refuse to subscribe if C# hooks already registered. csharp_only=skip WASM loading for this mod.

managedSdkVersion.description: Optional. Declares which managed SDK version this mod's C# DLLs were compiled against. Format: MAJOR.MINOR (e.g. '1.0'). Major version must match the game's ManagedSdkVersion. Omit if the mod ships no managed DLLs (WASM-only mods can omit this).

permissions.description: Requested mod permissions. world.read (ReadWorld) lets a script read countries, wars, alliances, provinces, flags and variables; flags.write (WriteFlags / write_flags) lets it change flags and variables. Both need wasmAbiVersion 4 for WASM scripts.

author.description: Author name shown to players. Informational.

tags.description: Free-form category tags (e.g. "scenario", "balance"). Informational: they never change how the mod loads.

gameVersion.description: Semver range of game versions the mod was made for, e.g. "^0.5.0" or ">=0.5.0 <0.7.0". Outside it the Mods panel warns and the mod still loads.

dependencies.description: Mods that must be enabled for this one to load: a mod id, or id@range to require a version range (e.g. "example.base@^1.2.0"). Dependencies always load first. A dependency that is not installed, not enabled, outside the range or unable to load stops this mod from loading and is reported on the Mods panel; so is a dependency cycle.

loadOrderHint.description: Load position among mods that do not depend on each other: lower loads first, higher loads later and wins conflicting overrides. An engine event id is the exception: it stays with the first mod in load order, and a later mod's event with the same id is skipped. Ties load in mod id order. Default 0.
